name: Mini cart
summary: Cart in a Slideout. Opens from the Cart button in the header or after "Add to cart".
use: A quick overview without leaving the page.
avoid: As a replacement for the cart page: always link to it.
anatomy: Slideout (sm) with a title and the number of items.
Cart items (sm) in the Content slot.
Cart button: icon with a count.
reactProps: { title(n), subtotal, checkout, viewCart, emptyTitle, emptyText, continueShopping }
behaviour: Focus goes to the panel and stays there. Escape closes it and moves focus back (Slideout).
a11y: The count is part of the name of the Cart button. The badge itself is aria-hidden.
dont: Close automatically after a few seconds.
